'''Belkadan''' was a forested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a world of tall [[dalloralla tree]]s and small natural bodies of water.<ref name="TNJOS" />

==History==
Around [[30,000 BBY]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]], Belkadan was ruled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] which dominated much of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] through their interstellar [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. With the collapse of the Empire five thousand years later, the Rakatans retreated to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], leaving little trace as to how and why they left.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Luke_Onslaught.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on Belkadan.]]
Millennia later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Yuon Par]], who specialized in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] pre-history, led expeditions to planets such as [[Malachor III]], Belkadan, and [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Later, the government on Belkadan was overthrown and replaced with a puppet government that was loyal to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TL6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Belkadan was the location of the outpost of [[ExGal-4]], established by [[Extragalactic Society|ExGal]] President [[Tobbert Dalonbian]]. The planet Belkadan was overrun by [[Praetorite Vong]] agent [[Yomin Carr]], who had assumed the identity of an ExGal-4 scientist. The atmosphere of Belkadan was also altered due to a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Dweebit|beetle]] that excreted massive amounts of carbon dioxide and sulfur.<ref name="Vector" /> After the destruction of ExGal-4, the Yuuzhan Vong bioweapon receded and the new Yuuzhan Vong [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] entering the galaxy built a shipyard there.<ref name="DT1" />
